## Rust — dash-sdk, dpp, drive, rs-dapi-client, drive-proof-verifier

> Major release. Hard source breaks: `Query::query` / `Fetch::Query` (§dash-sdk query layer), async `Signer` (§dpp), identity/top-up/asset-lock method renames (`*_with_private_key`), `AddressProvider` rework, new `StateTransition` / `DocumentType` / `Error` variants (exhaustive `match` breaks), `Network::Dash` → `Network::Mainnet` (dashcore 0.42), and the JSON wire shape (`$version` → `$formatVersion`). Most shielded-pool (Orchard) APIs are behind the `shielded` (dash-sdk) or `shielded-client` (dpp) feature.

## Rust — FFI & wallet (rs-sdk-ffi, platform-wallet, platform-wallet-ffi, rs-unified-sdk-ffi)

> Hard C-ABI breaks in `rs-sdk-ffi`: async completion-based signer callbacks, `DashSDKNetwork` → `FFINetwork` (Devnet/Regtest discriminants swapped), removed dash_unified_*. `platform-wallet` was rewritten around `PlatformWalletManager`/`PlatformWallet`; `platform-wallet-ffi` and `rs-unified-sdk-ffi` are new crates. Rows tagged "since rc.2" changed between v4.0.0-rc.2 and v4.0.0.

| `SignAsyncCallback` | rs-sdk-ffi | ± | `dash_sdk_signer_create(sign_async_callback, can_sign_callback, destroy_callback)` now takes a completion-based `SignAsyncCallback(signer, pubkey_bytes, pubkey_len, key_type, data, data_len, completion_ctx, completion)` instead of synchronous `SignCallback`. `CanSignCallback` now gets raw pubkey bytes + `key_type: u8` (KeyType discriminant) instead of a bincode `IdentityPublicKey`. `SignerVTable` is now `{sign_async, can_sign_with, destroy}`; the `free_result` slot added by #3304 is gone (Rust copies the signature bytes); `VTableSigner` fields are private. | Rewrite signer callbacks: look the key up by raw pubkey bytes + `key_type`, then call `completion(completion_ctx, sig, sig_len, NULL)` exactly once (or pass a non-null `error_message` on failure). | [PR:3492] [PR:3541] |
| `dash_sdk_signer_create_with_ctx` | rs-sdk-ffi | + | Signer constructor that carries a caller `ctx` pointer: (ctx, SignAsyncCallback, CanSignCallback, DestroyCallback) -> *mut SignerHandle. `dash_sdk_sign_async_completion` is exported so C/Swift can complete a pending sign. | Additive; use when the callback needs per-instance state (e.g. Swift `KeychainSigner`). | [PR:3541] [PR:3492] |

## gRPC — dapi-grpc

> All proto changes are in `platform/v0/platform.proto` and are wire-additive. No proto changes between v4.0.0-rc.2 and v4.0.0. Not listed (added and removed again inside v3.0.2..v4.0.0, so never in a stable release): the standalone getDocumentsCount / getDocumentsSplitCount RPCs (added in PR 3435, folded into `getDocuments` v1 by PR 3633) and the four shielded nullifier-changes / trunk / branch RPCs (added in PR 3228, removed in PR 3823).

| Keyword | Service | Δ | Change | Migration | Ref |
|---------|---------|---|--------|-----------|-----|
| `Platform.getDocumentHistory` | Platform | + | New RPC `getDocumentHistory(GetDocumentHistoryRequest) returns (GetDocumentHistoryResponse)`. `GetDocumentHistoryRequestV0`: `data_contract_id`, `document_type_name`, `document_id`, `limit`/`offset` (`google.protobuf.UInt32Value`), `start_at_ms` (uint64, JS_STRING), `prove`. Response `GetDocumentHistoryResponseV0` is `oneof result { DocumentHistory document_history; Proof proof }`, where `DocumentHistory.document_entries` is a list of `DocumentHistoryEntry { date, value }`. | Additive. Regenerate stubs. `limit` must be in `1..=MAX_DOCUMENT_HISTORY_FETCH_LIMIT`. | [PR:3725] |
| `Platform.getShieldedEncryptedNotes` | Platform | + | New RPC for paginated Orchard encrypted notes. `GetShieldedEncryptedNotesRequestV0 { start_index, count, prove }`. Response `EncryptedNotes.entries` is a list of `EncryptedNote { nullifier, cmx, encrypted_note, cv_net }`. `cv_net` (32-byte value commitment, used for OVK recovery of outgoing notes) was added in PR 3819. | Additive. Regenerate stubs. | [PR:3228] [PR:3819] |
| `Platform.getShieldedAnchors` | Platform | + | New RPC. `GetShieldedAnchorsRequestV0 { prove }`. Response `oneof result { Anchors anchors; Proof proof }`, where `Anchors.anchors` is `repeated bytes`. Returns the valid anchors for Orchard spend proofs. | Additive. Regenerate stubs. | [PR:3228] |
| `Platform.getMostRecentShieldedAnchor` | Platform | + | New RPC. `GetMostRecentShieldedAnchorRequestV0 { prove }`. Response `oneof result { bytes anchor; Proof proof }`. | Additive. Regenerate stubs. | [PR:3228] |
| `Platform.getShieldedPoolState` | Platform | + | New RPC. `GetShieldedPoolStateRequestV0 { prove }`. Response `oneof result { uint64 total_balance; Proof proof }` (JS_STRING). It returns only the pool's total balance. The 4.0.0-rc.2 changelog wrongly described it as "note count, tree root, height". | Additive. Regenerate stubs. To get the note count, use `getShieldedNotesCount`. | [PR:3228] |
| `Platform.getShieldedNotesCount` | Platform | + | New RPC. `GetShieldedNotesCountRequestV0 { prove }`. Response `oneof result { uint64 total_notes_count; Proof proof }`. Returns the leaf count of the shielded commitment tree, used as the denominator for sync progress. | Additive. Regenerate stubs. | [PR:3769] |
| `Platform.getShieldedNullifiers` | Platform | + | New RPC. `GetShieldedNullifiersRequestV0 { repeated bytes nullifiers; prove }`. Response `NullifierStatuses.entries` is a list of `NullifierStatus { nullifier, is_spent }`. The 4.0.0-rc.2 changelog attributed it to PR 3819, but it was introduced in PR 3228. | Additive. Regenerate stubs. | [PR:3228] |
| `GetDocumentsRequestV1` | Platform | + | `GetDocumentsRequest.version` oneof gains `v1 = 2` (SQL-shaped). Fields: `data_contract_id`, `document_type`, `repeated WhereClause where_clauses`, `repeated OrderClause order_by`, `optional uint32 limit`, `oneof start { start_after, start_at }`, `prove`, `repeated Select selects` (`Select.Function`: `DOCUMENTS`/`COUNT`/`SUM`/`AVG`/`MIN`/`MAX` + `field`), `repeated string group_by`, `repeated HavingClause having`, `optional uint32 offset`. Servers reject unsupported shapes with `Unsupported`: any `having`, any `offset`, `MIN`/`MAX`, and more than one `selects` entry. | Additive; `v0` (CBOR `where`/`order_by`) is unchanged. Prefer `v1` for count/sum/avg; do not depend on `having`/`offset` yet. | [PR:3633] [PR:3654] [PR:3661] |
| `WhereClause` | Platform | + | New typed messages nested in `GetDocumentsRequest`: `WhereClause { field, WhereOperator operator, DocumentFieldValue value }`, enum `WhereOperator` (`EQUAL`…`STARTS_WITH`, 11 values), `DocumentFieldValue` oneof (`bool_value`/`int64_value`/`uint64_value`/`double_value`/`text`/`bytes_value`/`list`/`null_value`), and `OrderClause`. Used only by `GetDocumentsRequestV1`. | Additive. Non-Rust clients no longer need a CBOR encoder for v1 queries. | [PR:3654] |
| `HavingClause` | Platform | + | New `HavingClause { HavingAggregate aggregate; Operator operator; oneof right { DocumentFieldValue value; HavingRanking ranking } }`, plus `HavingAggregate` (`COUNT`/`SUM`/`AVG` + `field`) and `HavingRanking` (`MIN`/`MAX`/`TOP`/`BOTTOM`, optional `n`). The wire shape is reserved: any non-empty `having` is rejected (`HAVING clause is not yet implemented`). ⚠ PR #3654 describes `having` as `repeated WhereClause`, but the code shows `repeated HavingClause having = 11`. | Do not send `having` against v4.0.0 servers. | [PR:3654] |
| `GetDocumentsResponseV1` | Platform | + | `GetDocumentsResponse.version` oneof gains `v1 = 2`: `oneof result { ResultData data; Proof proof }` + `metadata`. `ResultData` is a oneof of `Documents documents`, `CountResults counts`, `SumResults sums` or `AverageResults averages`. Each `*Results` type is either an aggregate (`aggregate_count`/`aggregate_sum`/`aggregate_average`) or `entries` (`CountEntry`/`SumEntry`/`AverageEntry` with `optional bytes in_key`, `key`). 64-bit values use `jstype = JS_STRING`. | Additive. Handle the `v1` oneof when you send `GetDocumentsRequestV1`. | [PR:3633] [PR:3661] |
| `GetRecentAddressBalanceChangesRequestV0` | Platform | + | New field `bool start_height_exclusive = 3`. When true, the start is exclusive (RangeAfter), so `start_height` becomes a proof boundary node, which enables compaction detection. | Additive. The default `false` keeps the old inclusive behaviour. | [PR:3377] |
| `GetDocumentsRequestV0` | Platform | ± | Wire is unchanged, but behaviour is stricter. A malformed `order_by` CBOR (a non-array top level, or a clause that fails to parse) now returns `QuerySyntaxError::InvalidOrderByProperties`. Before, such clauses were silently dropped and the default ordering was used. | Make sure the `order_by` CBOR is a well-formed array of valid order clauses. | [PR:3654] |

## JS/TS — @dashevo/evo-sdk, @dashevo/wasm-sdk, @dashevo/wasm-dpp2, @dashevo/wasm-dpp, @dashevo/dapi-client, @dashevo/wasm-drive-verify

> This is a major release. Most of the breaks come from the wasm-dpp2 API standardisation (PR 2999): `getX()` methods became property getters, positional constructors became options objects, u64 values are BigInt only, and parameter names are camelCase. Other major breaks: `Map` results are now keyed by `string` (PR 3145), the trusted context is per instance (PR 3043), and the JSON shapes changed (PR 3167). Changes from v4.0.0-rc.2 to v4.0.0 are PR 3912 (`withTrustedContext`) and PR 3865 (`TokenPricingScheduleEmptyError`). This section also corrects the 4.0.0-rc.2 JS rows: wasm-dpp `lib/index.ts` lost only a trailing blank line; the `deriveKeyFromSeedPhrase` return type did not change; and wasm-dpp2 is not a new package (it gained ~17k lines of API).

| Keyword | Module | Δ | Change | Migration | Ref |
|---------|--------|---|--------|-----------|-----|
| `StateTransitionsFacade` | js-evo-sdk | + | New facade at `sdk.stateTransitions` with `broadcastStateTransition`, `waitForResponse`, `broadcastAndWait` and `waitForStateTransitionResult`. `waitForResponse`/`broadcastAndWait` resolve to the typed `StateTransitionProofResultType` instead of `unknown`. | Additive. Narrow results on the `Verified*` class (`__struct`). | [PR:3077] |
| `waitForStateTransitionResult` | js-evo-sdk | − | Removed from `SystemFacade` and moved to `StateTransitionsFacade`. | `sdk.system.waitForStateTransitionResult(h)` → `sdk.stateTransitions.waitForStateTransitionResult(h)`. | [PR:3077] |
| `ShieldedFacade` | js-evo-sdk | + | New read-only facade at `sdk.shielded`: `poolState`, `encryptedNotes(startIndex, count)`, `anchors`, `mostRecentAnchor`, `nullifiers(nullifiers)`. Each has a `*WithProof` variant. Building, proving and broadcasting shielded transitions is not exposed. | Additive. | [PR:3235] |
| `DocumentsFacade.history` | js-evo-sdk | + | New `history(query: DocumentHistoryQuery)` / `historyWithProof` returning `Map<bigint, Document>` (keyed by history-entry timestamp, ms). Wraps `WasmSdk.getDocumentHistory`. | Additive. | [PR:3725] |
| `DocumentsFacade.count` | js-evo-sdk | + | New aggregate queries: `count(query)`, `sum(query, sumProperty)`, `average(query, averageProperty)` (returns `{ count, sum }` per key), each with a `*WithProof` variant. The results are `Map<string, bigint>`. The contract index must be declared countable/summable. Unsupported shapes are rejected by the server. | Additive. | [PR:3767] [PR:3661] [PR:3623] |
| `TokensFacade.configUpdate` | js-evo-sdk | + | New `configUpdate(options: TokenConfigUpdateOptions): Promise<TokenConfigUpdateResult>`, which wraps `WasmSdk.tokenConfigUpdate`. | Additive. | [PR:3038] |
| `EvoSDK.devnetTrusted` | js-evo-sdk | + | First-class devnet support. `network: 'devnet'`, new `devnetName` and `quorumUrl` options, `EvoSDK.devnet(name, opts)` (needs `addresses`), `EvoSDK.devnetTrusted(name, opts)` (prefetches quorums from `https://quorums.<name>.networks.dash.org`), and `withAddresses(…, 'devnet')`. The constructor throws on misconfiguration: `devnetName` on a non-devnet network, `quorumUrl` without `trusted`, or a non-trusted devnet without addresses. | Replace the testnet masquerade `new EvoSDK({ network: 'testnet', trusted: false, addresses })` with `EvoSDK.devnetTrusted('<name>')`. | [PR:3748] |
| `EvoSDK.connect` | js-evo-sdk | ± | `connect()` prefetches a per-instance `WasmTrustedContext` only when `trusted: true` and attaches it with `withTrustedContext`. In v3.0.2 quorums were always prefetched into process-global statics, so `{ addresses, trusted: false }` still verified proofs. Now that combination uses the non-trusted `WasmContext`, and proof-verified queries fail with "Non-trusted mode is not supported in WASM". Since v4.0.0 (PR 3912), `trusted: true` + `addresses` keeps the caller's addresses (in v4.0.0-rc.x they were replaced by discovered ones). | Pass `trusted: true` (or use `*Trusted()` factories) whenever you need proof verification, including with custom `addresses`. | [PR:3043] [PR:3912] |
| `IdentitiesFacade.balances` | js-evo-sdk | ± | Every facade that returns a `Map` is now keyed by `string` instead of `Identifier`/`PlatformAddress` objects: identities, tokens, documents, contracts, group, epoch, voting, and `AddressesFacade` (`getMany`, `transfer`, `withdraw`, `fundFromAssetLock`). Keys are base58 for identifiers and hex for platform addresses and ProTxHashes. | `map.get(id)` → `map.get(id.toBase58())`; drop `.toBase58()`/`.toHex()` calls on keys while iterating. | [PR:3145] |
| `IdentitiesFacade.nonce` | js-evo-sdk | ± | TS-only: optional results are typed `T \| undefined` instead of `T \| null`. Affected: `nonce`, `contractNonce`, `balance`, `balances`, `balanceAndRevision`, `byPublicKeyHash` (+`WithProof`), `fetchWithProof`, `DpnsFacade.usernameWithProof`/`getUsernameByNameWithProof`, `TokensFacade.totalSupplyWithProof`, `AddressesFacade.getWithProof`. `SystemFacade.totalCreditsInPlatform`/`prefundedSpecializedBalance` drop `\| undefined`. `unknown` proof types become concrete. Runtime unchanged. | Replace `=== null` checks with `== null` or `=== undefined`. | [PR:3047] |
| `IdentifierLikeArray` | js-evo-sdk | ± | Array parameters are typed with the named aliases `IdentifierLikeArray`, `PlatformAddressLikeArray` and `ProTxHashLikeArray`. Public-key-hash parameters use `PublicKeyHashLike`. `ProtocolFacade.versionUpgradeVoteStatus` takes `ProTxHashLike \| undefined` (was `string \| Uint8Array`). `EpochFacade.evonodesProposedBlocksByIds` takes `ProTxHashLikeArray` (was `string[]`). | Mostly source-compatible. Fix TS errors where narrower types are passed. | [PR:3047] [PR:2999] |
| `SystemFacade.pathElements` | js-evo-sdk | ± | `path`/`keys` are now `GrovePathSegment[]` (`string \| Uint8Array`), which allows binary grove keys. | Existing `string[]` calls still compile. | [PR:3657] |
| `TokensFacade.contractInfo` | js-evo-sdk | ± | Parameter renamed `contractId` → `tokenId` (docs and TS). It always took a token ID. | Pass a token ID (`TokensFacade.calculateId(contractId, position)`), not a contract ID. | [PR:3851] |

## Swift — swift-sdk

> The public surface grew from about 80 to about 360 types: wallet, persistence, DPP and signer code moved into the SDK from the example app. The breaking changes are: `Network` is now a Swift enum, network parameters were removed from `WalletManager`/`Wallet`, and `SPVClient`, the Tx builder, the placeholder `Identity`/`DataContract` classes and `ManagedWallet` were removed. Rows tagged "since rc.2" changed between v4.0.0-rc.2 and v4.0.0.

| Keyword | Module | Δ | Change | Migration | Ref |
|---------|--------|---|--------|-----------|-----|
| `Network` | swift-sdk | ± | Was `typealias Network = DashSDKNetwork` (imported C enum). Now `public enum Network: UInt32` with cases `.mainnet=0, .testnet=1, .devnet=2, .regtest=3` and `init(ffiNetwork:)`. `KeyWalletNetwork` and `NetworkSet` are removed. Every `network: KeyWalletNetwork` parameter (`Wallet`, `KeyDerivation`, `Address.validate`/`getType`) is now `network: Network`. `KeyValidation.validatePrivateKeyForPublicKey` / `matchPrivateKeyToPublicKeys` take `network: Network` instead of `isTestnet: Bool`. | Replace `KeyWalletNetwork.x` / `DashSDKNetwork` values with `Network.x`. Replace `isTestnet: true` with `network: .testnet`. | [PR:3567] |
| `WalletManager` | swift-sdk | ± | The network is now fixed per manager by `init(network:)`. `init()` and `init(fromSPVClient:)` are removed. Per-call `network:` parameters are dropped (`getWallet(id:)`, `getReceiveAddress(walletId:accountIndex:)`, `getChangeAddress`, `getManagedAccount`, `currentHeight()`, `processTransaction`). `addWallet(mnemonic:accountOptions:)` no longer takes `passphrase`/`networks`. New: `getPlatformAddresses`, `ensurePlatformPaymentAccount`. | Create one `WalletManager(network:)` per network and remove the `network:` arguments. Wallets with a BIP39 passphrase can no longer be added via `addWallet`. | [PR:3531] [PR:3567] [PR:3627] [PR:3644] |
| `Wallet` | swift-sdk | ± | `init(mnemonic:passphrase:network:accountOptions:)` → `init(mnemonic:network:accountOptions:)` (passphrase removed). `init(nonOwningHandle:network:)` → `init(nonOwningHandle:)`. `getAccountCollection(network:)` → `getAccountCollection()`. `getBalance()` and `getAccountBalance(accountIndex:)` are removed. New: `addPlatformPaymentAccount(accountIndex:keyClass:)`. | Drop the passphrase and network arguments. Read balances from `PlatformWalletManager.accountBalances` or `ManagedCoreWallet.balance`. | [PR:2935] [PR:3079] [PR:3377] [PR:3567] [PR:3627] |
| `SPVClient` | swift-sdk | − | Removed with `SPVClientDelegate`, `SPVSyncProgress`, `SPVSyncStage`, `SPVStats`, `SPVError` and the other SPV event types.
